Problem

I solved the problem of several clients who were still using chatbots without LLM where it was still based on rules so it could not answer questions outside the rules, so I integrated a knowledge feature where LLM could read the current context.

Overview

One AI Assistant is a web-based AI chatbot plugin capable of providing intelligent answers from a client's dedicated knowledge base. This project is designed to help companies improve customer support efficiency with automated and interactive solutions.

Approach

  1. / 01Using the RAG System which can read the available context documents, so that some things cannot be reached by naughty users but can still be answered.
  2. / 02Implemented Clean Architecture, SOLID Principle

Outcome

  • LLM AI-based intelligent system with advanced capabilities that can receive multiple contexts to what is being asked.
  • easy to maintain and scaling

Features

  • Knowledge Base Custom
  • Social Media Client
